features.name: Flower Catalog Browsing
features.description: Customers can browse available flowers with images, descriptions, and prices.
user_stories: As a customer, I can browse flower categories so that I can find the perfect arrangement for my needs.
As a customer, I can view detailed flower information so that I can make an informed purchase decision.
acceptance_criteria: Given I am on the homepage, When I click on a flower category, Then I see all flowers in that category with images and prices.
Given I am viewing a flower, When I click on it, Then I see detailed description, price, availability, and customer reviews.

features.name: Shopping Cart Management
features.description: Customers can add flowers to cart, modify quantities, and proceed to checkout.
user_stories: As a customer, I can add flowers to my cart so that I can purchase multiple items at once.
As a customer, I can modify cart contents so that I can adjust my order before checkout.
acceptance_criteria: Given I am viewing a flower, When I click add to cart, Then the item appears in my cart with selected quantity.
Given I have items in cart, When I change quantity or remove items, Then the cart total updates immediately.

features.name: Order Placement and Payment
features.description: Customers can complete checkout with delivery details and payment processing.
user_stories: As a customer, I can enter delivery information so that flowers are sent to the correct address.
As a customer, I can pay securely online so that I can complete my flower order.
acceptance_criteria: Given I am at checkout, When I enter valid delivery details and payment info, Then my order is confirmed with order number.
Given I complete payment, When the transaction succeeds, Then I receive an email confirmation with delivery estimate.

features.name: Order Tracking
features.description: Customers can track their order status from preparation to delivery.
user_stories: As a customer, I can view my order status so that I know when to expect delivery.
As a customer, I can receive delivery notifications so that I am informed of order progress.
acceptance_criteria: Given I have placed an order, When I check order status, Then I see current status and estimated delivery time.
Given my order status changes, When it moves to out for delivery, Then I receive a notification via email or SMS.

features.name: Admin Order Management
features.description: Administrators can view, update, and manage customer orders and inventory.
user_stories: As an admin, I can view all orders so that I can manage fulfillment efficiently.
As an admin, I can update order status so that customers receive accurate delivery information.
acceptance_criteria: Given I am logged in as admin, When I access the orders dashboard, Then I see all orders with filters by status and date.
Given I am viewing an order, When I update its status, Then the customer receives a notification and status is saved.
